dimensions.name: patch
dimensions.source_text: patch = [p0, p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7]

definitions.name: N
definitions.source_text: let N[l in patch]     = sum(a in age, S[l, a] + E[l, a] + I[l, a] + R[l, a])

definitions.name: I_agg
definitions.source_text: let I_agg[l in patch] = sum(a in age, I[l, a])

transitions.name: infection
transitions.source_text:
infection[l in patch, a in age] : S[l, a] --> E[l, a]
    @ beta * seas * S[l, a] * (
        (I_agg[l] + 0.0000001) / N[l]
      + 0.05 * sum(q in patch, W[l, q] * I_agg[q] / N[q])
      )

transitions.name: progression
transitions.source_text: progression[l in patch, a in age] : E[l, a] --> I[l, a] @ 0.125 * E[l, a]

transitions.name: recovery
transitions.source_text: recovery[l in patch, a in age]    : I[l, a] --> R[l, a] @ 0.143 * I[l, a]

initial.source_text: S[l in patch, a in age] = 900
E[l in patch, a in age] = 10
I[l in patch, a in age] = 10
R[l in patch, a in age] = 80
